requirements.description: Psychiatrists, psychologists and licensed counsellors access a small number of highly sensitive records including psychotherapy notes and substance use disorder treatment records, under a high-complexity access model.
requirements.quote: Psychiatrists, psychologists, licensed counsellors
requirements.trigger: Clinician needs to view or disclose a behavioural health record
requirements.happyPath: Role is provisioned with behavioural health scope after two approvals; the clinician sees Part 2 records only where consent exists; disclosure requests are checked against consent before release, with a redisclosure prohibition attached; every access is reviewed individually.

requirements.title: Billing scope role provisioning for Revenue Cycle Analysts
requirements.description: The system must provide a Revenue Cycle Analyst role that is provisioned with a billing-specific access scope covering diagnosis and procedure codes and demographics.
requirements.quote: Role provisioned with billing scope

requirements.title: Minimum necessary scope excludes clinical narrative
requirements.description: Access for the Revenue Cycle Analyst persona is governed by minimum necessary: analysts receive codes and demographics only, and must not receive clinical notes or narrative.
requirements.quote: Minimum necessary is the governing principle: codes and demographics, no notes

requirements.title: Provisioning turnaround of 2 business days for analysts
requirements.description: Access provisioning for the Revenue Cycle Analyst role is expected to complete within 2 business days.
requirements.quote: Expected provisioning time: 2 business days

requirements.title: Baseline access volume monitoring per analyst
requirements.description: The system must establish a baseline access volume for each Revenue Cycle Analyst and flag deviations from that baseline for review, to counter the difficulty of detecting anomalies in high-volume access.
requirements.quote: Monitoring: baseline volume per analyst, flag on deviation

requirements.title: Volume outside baseline is flagged for review
requirements.description: Any analyst record-access volume falling outside the established baseline must be flagged and routed for review.
requirements.quote: Volume outside the baseline is flagged for review

requirements.title: Records opened from the claims queue rather than by search
requirements.description: Analysts must access patient records only by opening them from the assigned claims queue; ad hoc record lookup is not the access path for this role.
requirements.quote: Analyst works a claims queue; records open from the queue, not by search

requirements.title: Free-text patient name search disabled for billing role
requirements.description: The system must disable free-text search of patient names for the Revenue Cycle Analyst role.
requirements.quote: Free-text search of patient names is disabled for this role

requirements.title: Revenue Cycle Analyst works a claims queue
requirements.description: A Revenue Cycle Analyst is provisioned with billing scope, works through an assigned claims queue opening records from the queue, without free-text patient name search, while access volume is monitored against a baseline.
requirements.quote: Analyst works a claims queue; records open from the queue, not by search
requirements.trigger: Analyst is assigned claims to work in the billing queue
requirements.happyPath: Role is provisioned with billing scope; analyst opens records from the claims queue; name search remains disabled; access volume stays within baseline so no flag is raised.

requirements.title: High-volume access obscures anomalous behaviour
requirements.description: The high volume, narrow scope access pattern of billing staff is a recognised risk factor because it makes anomaly detection harder and allows a curious analyst to hide in the noise.
requirements.quote: Risk factors: volume makes anomaly detection harder; a curious analyst is hidden in the noise

requirements.title: No direct system access for external research partners
requirements.description: External academic research partners must not be granted direct interactive access to the system; data is provided only via generated extracts (bulk extract pattern rather than interactive access).
requirements.quote: No direct system access; extracts only

requirements.title: Data use agreement required before limited data set release
requirements.description: A limited data set may only be released to an external research partner after a data use agreement has been executed.
requirements.quote: Limited data set requires a data use agreement before release

requirements.title: Safe Harbor de-identification removes 18 identifier types
requirements.description: Fully de-identified research extracts must be produced using the Safe Harbor method, with all 18 identifier types removed.
requirements.quote: De-identification by Safe Harbor: 18 identifier types removed

requirements.title: IRB approval required and recorded before extract
requirements.description: No research extract may be generated until IRB approval has been obtained and recorded in the system.
requirements.quote: IRB approval required and recorded before any extract

requirements.title: Research extract turnaround of 2-4 weeks
requirements.description: The expected turnaround time from research request to released extract is 2 to 4 weeks.
requirements.quote: Expected turnaround: 2-4 weeks

requirements.title: Every research extract logged with institution and IRB
requirements.description: The system must log every research extract, capturing the requesting institution and the approving IRB.
requirements.quote: Monitoring: every extract logged with the requesting institution and the approving IRB

requirements.title: Privacy officer determines extract type
requirements.description: The privacy officer must determine whether a limited data set or a fully de-identified extract is appropriate for each research request.
requirements.quote: Privacy officer determines whether a limited data set or de-identified extract is appropriate

requirements.title: Extract released through secure transfer after review
requirements.description: Generated extracts must be reviewed prior to release and delivered to the research partner via secure transfer.
requirements.quote: Extract generated, reviewed and released through secure transfer

requirements.title: Research extract recorded in accounting of disclosures
requirements.description: Each released research extract must be recorded in the accounting of disclosures.
requirements.quote: Extract recorded in the accounting of disclosures

requirements.title: Annual attestation from research institution
requirements.description: The research institution must provide an annual attestation confirming that the data has been handled in accordance with the data use agreement.
requirements.quote: Annual attestation from the institution that data has been handled per agreement

requirements.title: External research data request end-to-end
requirements.description: An external academic researcher under a data use agreement submits a research request with IRB documentation and receives an approved, logged extract.
requirements.quote: Research request received with IRB approval documentation
requirements.trigger: Research request received with IRB approval documentation
requirements.happyPath: Request received with IRB approval; privacy officer determines limited data set or de-identified extract; data use agreement executed if a limited data set; extract generated, reviewed and released through secure transfer; extract recorded in the accounting of disclosures; annual attestation received from the institution.

requirements.title: External research access is the highest scrutiny tier
requirements.description: External research partner access accounts for under 1% of total access volume and is subject to the highest level of scrutiny, with extreme access complexity.
requirements.quote: External Research Partner (under 1% of access, highest scrutiny)

requirements.title: Retention period determined by strictest applicable state rule
requirements.description: Where multiple state retention rules could apply to a record, the platform must determine the retention period per record using the strictest applicable rule.
requirements.quote: Retention determined per record by the strictest applicable rule

requirements.title: Patient treated in two states inherits the longer retention period
requirements.description: When a patient has been treated in two states with differing retention rules, the record inherits the longer of the applicable retention periods.
requirements.quote: A patient treated in two states inherits the longer period

requirements.title: Minor records retained until 10 years past age of majority
requirements.description: In one state, records for minors must be retained until 10 years past the age of majority, which can amount to a retention period of up to 28 years.
requirements.quote: Minors in one state must be retained until 10 years past the age of majority, which can be 28 years

requirements.title: Retention clock visible on the record
requirements.description: Each record must display its retention clock so that the applicable retention period and remaining time are visible to users viewing the record.
requirements.quote: Retention clock visible on the record

requirements.title: No bulk deletion path bypassing per-record retention rule
requirements.description: The platform must not provide any bulk deletion capability that can bypass the per-record retention rule evaluation.
requirements.quote: No bulk deletion path that can bypass the per-record rule

requirements.title: Disposal certificates retained after destruction
requirements.description: After a record is destroyed, a disposal certificate must be created and retained as evidence of compliant destruction.
requirements.quote: Disposal certificates retained after destruction

requirements.title: Balance early deletion violation against over-retention breach exposure
requirements.description: Retention handling must avoid both premature deletion, which is a statutory violation, and indefinite retention, which increases breach exposure.
requirements.quote: Deleting too early is a statutory violation; keeping everything forever raises breach exposure

requirements.title: Single platform supports three differing state retention rules
requirements.description: The platform must accommodate three separate state retention rule sets across three states within one system.
requirements.quote: Three states, three retention rules, one platform.

requirements.title: Risk-based triage of break-glass events
requirements.description: Break-glass access events must be triaged and prioritized by risk level rather than presented to reviewers as an undifferentiated flat list, so that a single privacy officer can handle the volume generated by 6,200 staff.
requirements.quote: Break-glass events triaged by risk, not presented as a flat list

requirements.title: Mandatory individual review for same-surname, VIP and employee records
requirements.description: Break-glass access involving a same-surname match, a VIP patient, or an employee's own record must always be reviewed individually and may never be batch-reviewed.
requirements.quote: Same-surname, VIP and employee-record access always reviewed individually

requirements.title: Batch review permitted for ED break-glass during documented trauma activation
requirements.description: Break-glass events originating in the emergency department during a documented trauma activation are eligible for batch review rather than individual review.
requirements.quote: Emergency department break-glass during a documented trauma activation may be reviewed in batch

requirements.title: Every break-glass event has a recorded decision
requirements.description: Regardless of which review path an event follows (individual or batch), a review decision must be recorded for every break-glass event.
requirements.quote: Every event has a decision recorded, whatever the review path

requirements.title: Break-glass review program must be defensible in survey
requirements.description: The organization cannot review every break-glass event with its current team, but performing no review is not defensible during a survey; the review approach must therefore demonstrate coverage of all events through a defensible, risk-prioritized process.
requirements.quote: Reviewing nothing is not defensible in a survey

requirements.title: Missed inappropriate access can escalate to a reportable breach
requirements.description: A single inappropriate access that is missed during break-glass review can become a reportable breach, so triage must minimize the risk of high-risk events going unreviewed.
requirements.quote: A single missed inappropriate access can become a reportable breach

requirements.title: Report incidents to payers within contractual window shorter than HIPAA's 60 days
requirements.description: As a business associate for two payers, MRH must report security incidents to the affected payer inside the payer's contractual notification window, which is shorter than the 60-day window allowed under HIPAA. The system must track and enforce the shorter contractual deadline rather than the regulatory default.
requirements.quote: Incident reporting to the payer within their contractual window, which is shorter than HIPAA's 60 days

requirements.title: Generate annual security attestation from system evidence
requirements.description: The system must produce the annual security attestation for payers automatically from evidence already held in the system, rather than requiring staff to assemble the attestation manually.
requirements.quote: Annual security attestation produced from system evidence, not assembled by hand

requirements.title: Document subcontractor flow-down for every vendor touching payer data
requirements.description: For each vendor that touches payer data, MRH must hold documented evidence that business associate obligations have been flowed down to that subcontractor. Coverage must be complete — every such vendor, with no gaps.
requirements.quote: Subcontractor flow-down documented for every vendor touching payer data

requirements.title: Support dual role as covered entity and business associate
requirements.description: MRH operates as a business associate for two payers in addition to being a covered entity, so compliance controls must satisfy both sets of obligations simultaneously.
requirements.quote: MRH is a business associate for two payers, not only a covered entity.

requirements.title: Support 4.2 million patient records
requirements.description: The system must operate at a scale of 4.2 million patient records.
requirements.quote: Patient records: 4.2 million

requirements.title: Handle 180,000-240,000 PHI access events per day
requirements.description: The system must capture and process a daily volume of 180,000 to 240,000 PHI access events.
requirements.quote: PHI access events: 180,000-240,000 per day

requirements.title: Handle 300-500 break-glass events per month
requirements.description: The system must support review and processing of 300 to 500 break-glass emergency access events each month.
requirements.quote: Break-glass events: 300-500 per month

requirements.title: Handle 220-400 right-of-access requests per month
requirements.description: The system must support intake and fulfilment of 220 to 400 patient right-of-access requests per month.
requirements.quote: Right-of-access requests: 220-400 per month

requirements.title: Handle 15-30 amendment requests per month
requirements.description: The system must support processing of 15 to 30 record amendment requests per month.
requirements.quote: Amendment requests: 15-30 per month

requirements.title: Handle 5-15 accounting of disclosures requests per month
requirements.description: The system must support 5 to 15 accounting of disclosures requests each month.
requirements.quote: Accounting of disclosures requests: 5-15 per month

requirements.title: Handle 8-12 research extracts per quarter
requirements.description: The system must support production of 8 to 12 research data extracts per quarter.
requirements.quote: Research extracts: 8-12 per quarter

requirements.title: Automation required to work within a five-person privacy team
requirements.description: With a privacy team of only 5 staff, the solution must rely on automation to prioritise and review the material events rather than manual review of all volume.
requirements.quote: privacy team of 5. Automation is the only path to reviewing what matters.

requirements.title: Right-of-access fulfilment averages under 10 days
requirements.description: Average turnaround for patient right-of-access requests must fall below 10 days, improved from the current 26-day average.
requirements.quote: Right-of-access fulfilment under 10 days average, from 26

requirements.title: Privacy analyst log review time reduced by 70%
requirements.description: The system must reduce the time privacy analysts spend on access log review by 70% relative to the current baseline.
requirements.quote: Privacy analyst time on log review reduced by 70%

requirements.title: Break-glass review completed within 5 business days for all events
requirements.description: Every break-glass access event must have its review completed within 5 business days, with no exceptions (100% of events).
requirements.quote: Break-glass review completed within 5 business days for 100% of events

requirements.title: No Part 2 record access without recorded consent
requirements.description: There must be zero instances of access to 42 CFR Part 2 substance use disorder records where a consent record is not on file.
requirements.quote: Zero access to Part 2 records without a recorded consent

requirements.title: All PHI access captured in the audit log
requirements.description: 100% of accesses to protected health information must be recorded in the audit log.
requirements.quote: 100% of PHI access captured in the audit log

requirements.title: Breach risk assessments documented against all four factors
requirements.description: Every breach risk assessment must be documented against all four required factors, without exception.
requirements.quote: Breach risk assessments documented against all four factors, without exception

requirements.title: Retention applied per record by strictest applicable state rule
requirements.description: Retention periods must be determined and applied on a per-record basis using the strictest applicable state retention rule.
requirements.quote: Retention applied per record by the strictest applicable state rule

requirements.title: Audit evidence producible within 2 business days for a survey
requirements.description: The system must be able to produce audit evidence for a regulatory survey within 2 business days.
requirements.quote: Audit evidence producible for a survey within 2 business days

requirements.title: System uptime of 99.9%
requirements.description: The system must maintain 99.9% uptime.
requirements.quote: Uptime 99.9%

requirements.title: Record retrieval under 2 seconds at 95th percentile
requirements.description: Record retrieval response time must be under 2 seconds at the 95th percentile.
requirements.quote: Record retrieval under 2 seconds at the 95th percentile

requirements.title: Support 200 concurrent clinical users
requirements.description: The system must support 200 concurrent clinical users.
requirements.quote: 200 concurrent clinical users supported
